:::{#thm-mutual-information-joint-minus-conditionals}
#### Mutual information from the conditional entropies

For [discrete random variables](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv) $X$ and $Y$
with finite entropies, <!-- check-term-links: allow -->

$$I(X; Y) = \entropyf{X, Y} - \sb{\entropyf{X \mid Y} + \entropyf{Y \mid X}}.$$

:::

::: {.proof}

By @cor-conditional-entropy-difference and the [chain rule](#thm-entropy-chain-rule),
the [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) of each variable
is the [joint entropy](#def-joint-entropy)
minus a [conditional entropy](#def-conditional-entropy):

$$
\begin{aligned}
\entropyf{X} &= \entropyf{X, Y} - \entropyf{Y \mid X} \\
\entropyf{Y} &= \entropyf{X, Y} - \entropyf{X \mid Y}.
\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting both into @def-mutual-information gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
I(X; Y)
&= \entropyf{X} + \entropyf{Y} - \entropyf{X, Y} \\
&= \sb{\entropyf{X, Y} - \entropyf{Y \mid X}} + \sb{\entropyf{X, Y} - \entropyf{X \mid Y}} - \entropyf{X, Y} \\
&= \entropyf{X, Y} - \sb{\entropyf{X \mid Y} + \entropyf{Y \mid X}}.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
